title: tatara.json
description: What a tatara app was created with; read by the tatara CLI's generators.

version.description: tatara version the app was created with

generated.description: Written by tatara new / tatara upgrade: the CLI version and a hash of each framework file it wrote. Used by tatara upgrade.

ejected.description: Written by tatara eject: each package copied into src/ejected, with the version it was ejected at. tatara upgrade leaves these alone.

paths.description: Where the app keeps what a package's commands and seeds import, when it isn't the default: default path → the app's path, e.g. { "#core/authz/index": "#modules/authorization/index" }.

registries.description: App-declared discovery kinds: tatara sync writes each one's matched files as one typed list to src/generated/<name>.ts.

name.description: Identifier: the file is src/generated/<name>.ts and exports const <name>.

glob.description: Globs from the app root; *.test.ts and *.d.ts are skipped.

export.description: What each file contributes: "default", "*" (the module namespace) or a named export.

each.description: item: one T per file; array: a T[] per file, spread into the list; record: a Record<string, T> per file.

type.description: The item type T; leave out import for global types such as string.

shape.description: list: the values; entries: { owner, file, value }, owner "module:<name>" or "core:<name>".

unique.description: A field no two items may share; the generated module throws on load otherwise. Not with each: record.
